Continuation of the aborted PR3 apply. The previous run had created an untracked

### Enablement / reliability fixes

- **Api type surface** (`apps/web/src/lib/api.ts`): typed `FetchLike` so mocks can be
  functions; `sampler`/`scheduler` optional; matches server contract.
- **Npm state repair**: restored `apps/web/package.json` deps matching the lockfile; removed
  a stale nested `apps/web/node_modules` (non-historically duplicate vite); upgraded `vite`
  to `^7.3.6` to resolve a duplicate-vite type conflict.
- **Test race fixed** (`scripts/copy-template.mjs`): the copy was a plain `copyFileSync` that
  a parallel converter-read could observe mid-write, and a naive `renameSync` failed with
  EPERM on Windows because another worker held a transient read handle. Copy is now atomic
  ( temp file → `renameWithRetry`) so readers observe an old or new, never partial, template.
